_comment: Single source of content for the whole site. Migrated from the v1 portfolio (src/data/user_info.js) and the v2 Next app. Edit here and nowhere else — src/lib/{site,work,experience,skills}.ts are typed views over this file, not separate copies. Counters in the hero derive from array lengths, so adding an entry moves the numbers.

description.en: Fresh graduate in Information Technology with a strong passion for software development. Experienced in web and mobile application development using Node.js, PHP, JavaScript, Golang and Laravel. Skilled in SQL database management and API development, and familiar with front-end work in React. Strong in problem-solving and teamwork, with a focus on building efficient, scalable solutions.
description.id: Lulusan baru Teknologi Informasi dengan minat kuat pada pengembangan perangkat lunak. Berpengalaman membangun aplikasi web dan mobile dengan Node.js, PHP, JavaScript, Golang, dan Laravel. Terbiasa mengelola basis data SQL dan membangun API, serta familier dengan pengembangan front-end memakai React. Kuat dalam pemecahan masalah dan kerja tim, dengan fokus pada solusi yang efisien dan mudah diskalakan.

bio.en: As a back-end engineer I focus on the server-side of applications and on making sure they work well with the front end. I work across Node.js, PHP, Java and Golang, with a lot of time spent in Laravel, and I contribute across the whole development process rather than just my slice of it. Alongside the back end I build front-ends in React and manage SQL databases. I follow established practices to build systems that scale, keep databases clean and test thoroughly — the aim being a codebase where the front and back ends meet without friction.
bio.id: Sebagai back-end engineer, fokus saya ada di sisi server aplikasi dan memastikannya bekerja mulus dengan front-end. Saya bekerja dengan Node.js, PHP, Java, dan Golang, dengan waktu terbanyak di Laravel, dan terlibat di seluruh proses pengembangan — bukan hanya bagian saya sendiri. Selain back-end, saya membangun front-end dengan React dan mengelola basis data SQL. Saya mengikuti praktik yang sudah mapan agar sistem mudah diskalakan, basis data tetap rapi, dan pengujian dilakukan menyeluruh — tujuannya satu: tempat front-end dan back-end bertemu tanpa gesekan.

contactCopy.en: Thank you for reaching out. If there's something specific you'd like to discuss, email me directly — I aim to reply within 24 hours, though it can take a little longer when things are busy. You're also welcome to connect on any of the links below.
contactCopy.id: Terima kasih sudah menghubungi. Kalau ada yang ingin dibicarakan secara spesifik, kirim email langsung — saya berusaha membalas dalam 24 jam, meski bisa lebih lama saat sedang padat. Silakan juga terhubung lewat tautan di bawah.

points.en: Built an internal website using the Laravel framework.
points.id: Membangun website internal dengan framework Laravel.

points.en: Built the Kominfo attendance system using QR codes.
points.id: Membangun sistem absensi Kominfo berbasis QR code.

points.en: Built a website using React and Express.js.
points.id: Membangun website dengan React dan Express.js.

points.en: Built an application with the Flutter framework.

summary.en: A charging system for electric vehicle stations with digital payment built in. Drivers charge their car and settle securely online, which is what makes the stations practical to operate at scale.
summary.id: Sistem pengisian daya untuk stasiun kendaraan listrik dengan pembayaran digital. Pengemudi mengisi daya lalu membayar online dengan aman — itu yang membuat stasiunnya praktis dijalankan dalam skala besar.

summary.en: An e-commerce platform covering the whole of an online store — products, sales and customer interactions — on a Go service layer with Redis, PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ behind a Flutter app.
summary.id: Platform e-commerce yang mencakup seluruh operasi toko online — produk, penjualan, dan interaksi pelanggan — di atas layanan Go dengan Redis, PostgreSQL, dan RabbitMQ, dengan aplikasi Flutter di depannya.

summary.en: Warehouse inventory management covering item check-in and check-out, usage tracking and stock reporting — a Laravel 11 back end with a Flutter app handling QR code transactions on the floor.
summary.id: Manajemen inventaris gudang: barang masuk dan keluar, pelacakan pemakaian, dan pelaporan stok — back end Laravel 11 dengan aplikasi Flutter yang menangani transaksi QR code langsung di lapangan.

summary.en: A multilingual food ordering system: Flutter on the front, Go on the back, and a Laravel admin panel for the restaurant staff who actually run it day to day.
summary.id: Sistem pemesanan makanan multibahasa: Flutter di depan, Go di belakang, dan panel admin Laravel untuk staf restoran yang menjalankannya setiap hari.

summary.en: A full-stack educational platform for agriculture — forums, categorised articles and training videos supporting knowledge sharing between farming communities.
summary.id: Platform edukasi pertanian full-stack — forum, artikel berkategori, dan video pelatihan untuk menopang pertukaran pengetahuan antar komunitas petani.

summary.en: An employee attendance system built during the Kominfo placement: a structured way to record, track and manage absences so administrators keep accurate records without paper.
summary.id: Sistem absensi pegawai yang dibangun saat penempatan di Kominfo: cara terstruktur untuk mencatat, melacak, dan mengelola kehadiran agar administrator punya rekam data akurat tanpa kertas.

summary.en: A platform for farmers to borrow agricultural equipment — requesting, borrowing and tracking tools on one side, inventory and transaction monitoring for administrators on the other.
summary.id: Platform peminjaman alat pertanian — petani mengajukan, meminjam, dan melacak alat di satu sisi; administrator memantau inventaris dan transaksi di sisi lain.

summary.en: A RESTful API applying Clean Architecture: JWT authentication, middleware-protected routes and full CRUD for products and categories, in a layered structure built to stay testable.
summary.id: RESTful API yang menerapkan Clean Architecture: autentikasi JWT, rute terproteksi middleware, dan CRUD lengkap untuk produk dan kategori, dalam struktur berlapis yang dirancang tetap mudah diuji.

summary.en: A two-player Tic Tac Toe built in Vue, with win detection, draw conditions and a reset. Small on purpose — a clean place to get state handling exactly right.
summary.id: Tic Tac Toe dua pemain dengan Vue, lengkap dengan deteksi kemenangan, kondisi seri, dan reset. Sengaja kecil — tempat bersih untuk membuat penanganan state benar-benar rapi.
